question: Kalibangan sthal kis visheshta ke liye sabse prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Kalibangan (Hanumangarh, Ghaggar kinare) me jute hue khet ke sakshya mile — duniya me iska pehla praman. | Galat kyun: Bauddh stupa Bairat se juda hai; tamba Ahar ki pehchan hai; loha baad ki sanskriti se hai. | Concept: Harappan sthal ki pehchan uski vishesh khoj se hoti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kalibangan = juta hua khet (hal ke nishan). | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md; NCERT Ancient India.

question: Ahar sanskriti kis dhatu se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Ahar (Udaipur) Tamra-Yug sanskriti hai; yahan tambe ke upkaran mile; 'Tamravati' naam tambe se aaya. | Galat kyun: Loha, sona, chandi Ahar ki pehchan nahi hain. | Concept: Sanskriti ka naam uski pramukh dhatu se padta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ahar = Tamravati = Tamba. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Bairat (Viratnagar) se kis samrat ke shilalekh mile hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Bairat (Viratnagar, Jaipur) se Ashok ke shilalekh (Bhabru shilalekh) mile hain; yah Bauddh sthal bhi hai. | Galat kyun: Akbar, Harshvardhan, Kanishk ke shilalekh Bairat se nahi mile. | Concept: Shilalekh rajya aur kaal ka praman hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bairat = Bhabru = Buddha + Ashok. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Jodhpur ki sthapana kisne aur kab ki?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rao Jodha ne 1459 me Jodhpur ki sthapana ki. | Galat kyun: Rao Bika ne Bikaner (1488), Sawai Jai Singh II ne Jaipur (1727), Rawal Jaisal ne Jaisalmer (1156) basaya — teeno sahi jode hain, galat shahar ke saath. | Concept: Nagar-sthapana me sthapak + varsh ka joda yaad rakho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jodha-1459-Jodhpur. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Bikaner ki sthapana kab hui?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Rao Bika ne 1488 me Bikaner ki sthapana ki. | Galat kyun: 1156 Jaisalmer, 1727 Jaipur, 1459 Jodhpur ke varsh hain. | Concept: Sthapak-varsh ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bika-Bikaner-1488 (tinon 'B'). | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaipur ki sthapana kisne ki?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Sawai Jai Singh II ne 1727 me Jaipur basaya; usse pehle Amber rajdhani thi. | Galat kyun: Rao Jodha (Jodhpur), Rana Kumbha (Kumbhalgarh), Maharana Pratap (Mewar) — Jaipur se sambandh nahi. | Concept: Sthapak-varsh ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jai Singh ne Jaipur (naam me 'J'). | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Khanwa ka yuddh kab hua aur kin ke beech hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Khanwa (1527): Rana Sanga vs Babur; Babur vijayi hua. | Galat kyun: 1576 Haldighati hai; 1526 Panipat (Babur vs Ibrahim Lodi) hai; 1192 dusri Tarain hai. | Concept: Yuddh = varsh + dono paksh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Panipat (1526) ke ek saal baad Khanwa (1527) — wahi Babur. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Haldighati ka yuddh kab hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Haldighati 18 June 1576 ko Maharana Pratap vs Akbar ki sena (Man Singh) ke beech hua. | Galat kyun: 1527 Khanwa, 1582 Dewair, 1568 Chittorgarh jauhar ke varsh hain. | Concept: Yuddh = varsh + paksh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 18 June 1576 — Haldighati. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Maharana Pratap ka janm kahan aur kab hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Maharana Pratap ka janm 9 May 1540 ko Kumbhalgarh me hua. | Galat kyun: Haldighati yuddh-sthal hai (1576), janm-sthan nahi; Udaipur aur Chittorgarh janm-sthan nahi hain. | Concept: Janm-sthan aur yuddh-sthal alag hote hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pratap ka janm usi Kumbhalgarh me hua jise Kumbha ne banwaya tha. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Vijay Stambh kisne aur kyun banwaya?
option_b: Sawai Jai Singh, Jaipur sthapana par
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rana Kumbha ne 1448 me Chittorgarh me Vijay Stambh, Malwa (Mahmud Khilji) par vijay ke smaran me banwaya. | Galat kyun: Kirti Stambh Jain parisar me hai — alag stambh hai; Pratap aur Jodha ne ise nahi banwaya. | Concept: Stambh = vijay ka smarak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Vijay Stambh = Kumbha ki Malwa vijay (1448). | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan me 1857 ki kranti ka pehla vidroh kahan aur kab hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 28 May 1857 ko Nasirabad me Rajasthan ka pehla vidroh hua; phir Neemuch, Kota, Erinpura me faila. | Galat kyun: Kota aur Erinpura baad me hue; Jaipur me 1857 ka vidroh nahi hua. | Concept: Kranti ka prarambh-sthal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 28 May — Nasirabad se shuruaat. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Auwa ke Thakur Kushal Singh kis andolan/kranti se jude hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Auwa ke Thakur Kushal Singh 1857 kranti ke pramukh neta the. | Galat kyun: Bijolia (Vijay Singh Pathik), Non-cooperation (Gandhi yug), Praja Mandal (1930s) — alag andolan hain. | Concept: Vyakti ↔ andolan ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Auwa = 1857; Bijolia = Pathik. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Bijolia kisan andolan ka netritva kisne kiya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bijolia kisan andolan (1897–1941) ka netritva Vijay Singh Pathik ne kiya. | Galat kyun: Manikya Lal Verma (Mewar Praja Mandal), Hiralal Shastri (pehle CM), Arjun Lal Sethi (Jaipur) — Bijolia se nahi jude. | Concept: Andolan ↔ neta ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Bijolia ki ladai Pathik ne ladi. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Brihat Rajasthan ka gathan kab hua (Rajasthan Diwas)?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 30 Mar 1949 ko Brihat Rajasthan bana; isiliye Rajasthan Diwas 30 March ko manaya jata hai. | Galat kyun: 17 Mar 1948 Matsya Sangh, 1 Nov 1956 antim swaroop, 25 Mar 1948 Rajasthan Union hai. | Concept: Ekikaran ke 7 charan — har charan ki apni tareekh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sample chapter ki date chain — 17-25-18 / 30-15-26 / 1-11. | Source: samples/sample_01_history_integration_of_rajasthan.md.

question: Matsya Sangh ka gathan kab hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Matsya Sangh (Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur, Karauli) 17 Mar 1948 ko bana — ekikaran ka pehla charan. | Galat kyun: 26 Jan 1950 Sirohi, 30 Mar 1949 Brihat Rajasthan, 15 May 1949 United Greater Rajasthan hai. | Concept: Pehla charan = pehli tareekh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Matsya = 17 March — pehla charan. | Source: samples/sample_01_history_integration_of_rajasthan.md.

question: Vartaman Rajasthan ka swaroop kab bana?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 1 Nov 1956 ko Abu-Delwara aur Ajmer-Merwara shamil hue aur Sironj MP ko gaya — vartaman swaroop bana. | Galat kyun: 30 Mar 1949 Brihat Rajasthan, 26 Jan 1950 Sirohi, 15 May 1949 United Greater Rajasthan hai. | Concept: Antim charan = antim tareekh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 1 Nov 1956 — aakhri charan. | Source: samples/sample_01_history_integration_of_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ke pehle Mukhyamantri kaun the?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Hiralal Shastri Rajasthan ke pehle CM (1949) the; Vanasthali Vidyapith ke sansthapak bhi. | Galat kyun: Sukhadia sabse lambe samay tak CM rahe (pehle nahi); Bhajan Lal Sharma vartaman CM hain; Manikya Lal Verma Mewar ke neta the. | Concept: 'Pehle' aur 'sabse lambe samay tak' alag sawal hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pehle CM = Hiralal (H se). | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Sabse lambe samay tak Rajasthan ke Mukhyamantri kaun rahe?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Mohanlal Sukhadia lagbhag 17 varsh tak CM rahe — sabse lamba karyakal. | Galat kyun: Shastri pehle CM the (karyakal chhota); Vasundhara Raje ke do karyakal kul ~10 varsh; Bhajan Lal Sharma vartaman CM hain. | Concept: 'Sabse lambe samay tak' = kul karyakal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sukhadia = 17 saal — sabse lamba. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaisalmer ke Sonar Kile ki sthapana kab hui?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rawal Jaisal ne 1156 me Jaisalmer (Sonar Kila) ki sthapana ki. | Galat kyun: 1488 Bikaner, 1459 Jodhpur, 1727 Jaipur ke varsh hain. | Concept: Sthapak-varsh ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jaisal-Jaisalmer-1156. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Kumbhalgarh kile ka nirmata kaun hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Rana Kumbha ne Kumbhalgarh kila banwaya; yahi Maharana Pratap ka janm-sthan hai. | Galat kyun: Prithviraj (Ajmer/Delhi), Sanga (Khanwa), Pratap (janm-sthan hai, nirmata nahi). | Concept: Nirmata aur janm-sthan alag hote hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kumbhalgarh = Kumbha ka kila, Pratap ka janm. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Prithviraj Chauhan aur Muhammad Ghori ke beech dusri Tarain ladai kab hui?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Pehli Tarain 1191 (Prithviraj vijayi), dusri Tarain 1192 (Ghori vijayi). | Galat kyun: 1191 pehli ladai hai; 1527 Khanwa, 1576 Haldighati alag yuddh hain. | Concept: Pehli vs dusri — ek saal me vijeta badal gaya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 1191 Prithviraj, 1192 Ghori — ek saal me palat. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Chittorgarh ka jauhar 1568 me kis aakraman ke samay hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 1568 me Akbar ke Chittorgarh aakraman ke samay jauhar hua. | Galat kyun: Maratha, Babur aur Ghori is samay Chittorgarh par aakraman nahi kar rahe the. | Concept: Jauhar aakraman ke samay ka balidan tha. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 1568 — Akbar ka Chittor aakraman. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Dewair ka yuddh (1582) kiski vijay ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Dewair (1582) me Maharana Pratap vijayi hue — Haldighati (1576) ke baad unki punar-vijay; James Tod ne ise 'Mewar ka Marathon' kaha. | Galat kyun: Sanga (Khanwa 1527), Man Singh (Haldighati me Akbar ki ore), Akbar — Dewair me vijayi nahi hue. | Concept: Haar ke baad ki vijay bhi itihaas me darj hoti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Dewair 1582 — Pratap ki wapsi. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.

question: Jaipur Praja Mandal ki sthapana kab hui?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jaipur Praja Mandal 1931 me bana (Jamnalal Bajaj se juda). | Galat kyun: 1938 Mewar Praja Mandal ka varsh hai; 1942 Bharat Chhodo Andolan ka; 1921 me Jaipur Praja Mandal nahi bana. | Concept: Har Praja Mandal ki apni sthapana-tithi. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jaipur 1931, Mewar 1938 — Jaipur pehle. | Source: notes/01_history_rajasthan.md.
